description: THE style contract — single source of truth for what NumbahWan work looks and reads like. Three consumers: (1) tools/generation-contract.cjs injects it into every generation prompt as a negative-constraint + voice block, (2) the linters (ai-tell-corpus.json, ai-layout-lint, code-slop-lint) are its enforcement backstop, (3) the author agent's self-critique checklist is generated from it. Rule added ONCE here propagates to all three ends. Positive instruction (voice, decisions, specificity) lives here; negative regex enforcement stays in the linter corpora — the contract REFERENCES them, never duplicates patterns.
principle: Work passes as professional human work when it contains visible evidence of decisions made under constraints: specific numbers, named places, deliberate asymmetry, opinions with reasons. Slop is decision-avoidance — the statistical center. The contract's job is to force the decisions upstream so the linters have nothing to catch.

voice.summary: Direct, specific, grounded in the game's actual economy and Taipei-inspired city. States numbers and reasons. No throat-clearing, no hype, no narration of its own structure.
do: lead with the fact or the number, not the framing
name the place, set, mechanic, or constraint specifically
state WHY when making a claim (because supply is fixed / because drop-day load spikes 429s)
vary sentence length and rhythm; short sentences are allowed
let the market ledger, patch notes, and drop rates do the persuading

mustInclude: at least one specific number, name, or constraint drawn from the brief or live game data (price, drop rate, district, set name, date) per section
one concrete reason (a 'because') for any evaluative claim
neverDo: open with a framing sentence ('In the realm of', 'Let's delve into')
promo/puffery voice (nestled, hidden gem, world-class, vibrant)
spaced em-dashes — close them up or use a comma/colon
chat-assistant leakage (I hope this helps, let me know if)
selfCritique: Could this sentence appear on any other card game's site? If yes, rewrite with a NumbahWan-specific fact.
Is there a number or named thing in every section? If no, add one from the brief.
Did I state WHY anywhere, or only WHAT? Add the reason.
Read it aloud: does the rhythm vary, or does every sentence march at the same length?

mustInclude: comments that explain WHY (constraint, observed behavior, deliberate choice), never WHAT the next line does
deliberate error handling: rethrow, return a fallback, report stderr, or a comment stating why silence is correct
neverDo: narrative comments that restate the code below (// increment the counter)
`as any` or @ts-ignore/@ts-nocheck to silence the type system
doc-free silence at a decision point
selfCritique: Does every comment answer WHY (or document a route/boundary), or does some comment just narrate? Delete narration.
If this catch is silent, is that a decision with a stated reason, or a place failure disappears?
Did I narrow the type or just cast it away?

mustInclude: palette-grounded color (the game's green/gold, not stock indigo-purple)
a compositional anchor: something left-aligned, off-center, or rhythm-breaking
icon system: inline SVG or icon font, never emoji-as-chrome
neverDo: emoji used as button/link/heading icons (colour emoji in chrome)
opacity-only motion (choose HOW it moves: rise, scale, slide)
a grid of 8+ structurally identical cloned cards (drive from data, vary shape)
selfCritique: Is any colour emoji doing icon work in chrome? Swap for SVG.
Is any color here the model's default palette rather than ours?
Does anything move? Does it move a WAY, or just fade?
Would this layout read as hand-composed, or as a template with content poured in?

mustInclude: a Taiwan-specific cue (night market, temple roofline, betel-nut stall, MRT signage, mountain haze)
a camera/lens/exposure spec (35mm, f/1.8, golden hour, shallow depth)
palette anchored to the scene, not to 'vibrant cinematic'
neverDo: generic slop adjectives (stunning, breathtaking, masterpiece, 8k, cinematic, epic, award winning, trending on artstation)
CGI/render tells (octane render, unreal engine, hyper-detailed)
luxury cliché vocabulary with no scene behind it
selfCritique: Is there a real place and a real camera in this prompt, or only adjectives?
Could this prompt describe any city on earth? Anchor it to Taiwan.

exemplars.note: Golden files — generation calls anchor to the nearest exemplar (few-shot imitation beats prohibition). Each is hand-locked: it passes all linters clean and demonstrates the contract's positive voice. Files live in evals/style-exemplars/ — outside public/ so --all sweeps skip them, but NOT path-exempt: the pre-commit gate re-lints them on every edit, so an exemplar that stops passing clean is itself a defect (gold standard, continuously re-verified).

enforcement.upstream: tools/generation-contract.cjs builds the prompt block (--medium), self-critique checklist (--critique), and exemplar anchor (--exemplar) from this file for every generation call in the harness
enforcement.gate: pre-commit runs ai-tell-lint + ai-layout-lint (blocking) — the backstop, not the primary defense
enforcement.proof: npm run eval:linter grades the detectors; npm run eval (verify-tasks) proves the contract files stay wired
